name: Prairie State Conservation Fund (Stewardship Challenge Grant Program)

funder.name: Prairie State Conservation Coalition (funded by the Illinois Clean Energy Community Foundation)

summary: Illinois fund for natural habitat and wildlife areas. The Stewardship Challenge Grant gives 501(c)(3) organisations up to $30,000 for habitat restoration and stewardship on sites open to the public; the fund also covers land acquisition and capacity building.

amount.note: Stewardship Challenge Grant, paid in three parts: cash match, volunteer hours and equipment.

steps: Eligibility quiz, then full proposal in the grant portal

eligibility.rule: Site owned by a 501(c)(3) or government; applicant stewards it or plans to; habitat is or will be open to the public
Uses funds only for stewardship at the eligible project site

documents: Operating budgets for the most recent fiscal year and, if available, the upcoming one
Most recent fiscal year financial report
IRS Tax Status Determination Letter, for 501c3 applicants
Most recent Illinois Charitable Organization Annual Report, for 501(c)3 applicants

access.quote: Please click on Grant Portal to start a new application

amount.quote: Grantees are eligible to receive up to $30,000.

pool.quote: awarded a $47 million grant from the Illinois Clean Energy Community Foundation

co_finance_required.quote: Will there be a match requirement? Yes.

effort.quote: applicants will need to complete a basic eligibility quiz to ensure applicants organization and project sites are eligible under this program.

eligibility.quote: Eligible project sites are properties owned by a 501c3 organization, or a government agency, on which the applicant regularly performs, or is planning to regularly perform stewardship work, and is being managed as a natural habitat and wildlife area that is or will be open to the public.
All projects must be wholly in Illinois.
All funds provided by PSCC are to be dedicated to stewardship at the eligible project site identified in the grant application.

co_finance.quote: Cash donations: PSCC will provide $3 to every $1 raised toward the project within the grant period, up to $21,000.

after_award.quote: Take another set preceding the end of your grant period and submit both the "before" and "after" photos with your final report.

documents.quote: A completed Project Work Plan. This includes: Specific information about the natural areas and wildlife habitat on the project site Why the site needs stewardship, the objectives of the project, and the methods to be used to achieve those objectives. Information about the applicants volunteer base and plans to attract more volunteers and funders. A Project Budget

A letter of approval from the landowner of your project site approving the applicant to carry out the proposed grant work on the site. Maps showing the location of the work site Organizational or departmental operating budgets – one for the most recent fiscal year and one for the upcoming fiscal year, if available.

A financial report for the most recent fiscal year, including Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and any notes to the financial statements IRS letter confirming EIN IRS Tax Status Determination Letter (for 501c3 applicants only) Your organization's most recent Illinois Charitable Organization Annual Report filed with the Illinois Attorney General's Office (for 501(c)3 applicants only)
